title: Action
description: An action runs on one entity of a blueprint at a time, such as restarting a service: steps that call other systems over HTTP, write the catalog, check it, and say what the run gave. Every run is recorded, and people follow it on its run page.

blueprint.description: The blueprint whose entities the action runs on, one at a time. It shows on their pages.

group.description: The group it shows under in the Self-Service catalog, such as Operate, beside workflows of the same group. Left out, it shows under Other.

scope.description: Applies the action only to the entities that match. It can use $me.

run.description: Who can run it. Admins always can.

inputs.description: What people enter to run it, keyed by identifier, written as blueprint properties are. Steps read them as $input.<id>.

steps.description: What a run does, in order. A value can refer to what the run knows: $input.<id> an input, $entity the entity's identifier and $entity.<field> its fields, $me the requester's email and $me.id, .email, .name, .role and .groups, $run.id and $run.url, and $step.<id>.<field> what an earlier step gave. A string that is one reference becomes its value; {{ ref }} inside longer text becomes text.

outputs.description: What a run gives when it's done, keyed by name, as references such as $step.create.url.

access.description: Matches people with any of the roles, in any of the groups, or running it on an entity matching the filter.

groups.description: Group names from the identity provider.

filter.description: The entities they can run it on, with $me, such as those whose owner.members contains $me.

input.description: A value people enter. It's a relation when it has relation, otherwise a typed value.

storedInput.description: A value people enter, checked against its type and constraints.

pattern.description: String properties only: a regular expression (Go RE2 syntax) values must match.

minLength.description: String properties only: the fewest characters.

maxLength.description: String properties only: the most characters.

minimum.description: Number and integer properties only: the lowest value.

maximum.description: Number and integer properties only: the highest value.

relationInput.description: Identifiers of entities of a blueprint, which people pick.

relation.description: The blueprint whose entities it points at.

many.description: Holds a list of identifiers rather than one.

inputTitle.description: The input's label. Defaults to its identifier.

inputDescription.description: Help shown beside the input, saying what to enter.

valueType.description: The JSON type of the values. Dates and URLs are strings with a format.

format.description: String values only: what the text is, which decides how it's checked and shown.

enum.description: The only values allowed, of the property's type. String, number and integer properties only.

items.description: Array properties only: what each value in the list is. Defaults to strings.

typedValues.description: Ties format, items and enum values to the property's type.

step.description: One thing the run does. It takes exactly one of http, entity, check, sync, output and approval.

id.description: Names the step, so later steps can read what it gave as $step.<id>.<field>.

title.description: The step's label on the run page. Defaults to what it does.

timeout.description: How long one attempt may take, up to 10m. Defaults to 30s. Approval steps take approval.timeout instead.

onFailure.description: What the run does when the step fails. Defaults to stop.

retry.description: HTTP steps only: tries again after a network error, a 5xx or a 429, honouring Retry-After. Setting it says the other side takes repeats, so an interrupted step runs again.

attempts.description: How many more tries to make.

backoff.description: How long to wait before each, up to 5m.

httpStep.description: Calls a URL with a JSON body. It gives {status, body}, or what output picks. Every attempt sends the same Idempotency-Key header.

url.description: The http or https URL. It can hold {{ }} references.

headers.description: Request headers, keyed by name. Write secrets as {env: GP_SECRET_...}, read from the server's environment, never inline.

env.description: An environment variable of the server, starting with GP_SECRET_.

body.description: The JSON body, with references filled in. Not for GET.

success.description: The statuses that count as working. Defaults to any 2xx.

output.description: What the step gives, keyed by name: jq over {status, headers, body}.

entityStep.description: Writes or deletes an entity as an integration that doesn't pull. It gives identifier, title, blueprint and url.

operation.description: upsert creates the entity or updates the properties given, keeping the rest; delete removes it.

integration.description: The integration the entity is written as, one that doesn't pull. Only it can change the entity after.

identifier.description: The entity's identifier, such as $entity or $input.name.

syncStep.description: Syncs an integration that pulls, so what an earlier step changed at the source shows before the run ends. It waits for a sync already running, then runs its own, and fails when a resource can't be fetched. It gives mode, received, created, updated, unchanged, deleted and failed.

integration.description: The integration to sync. It must pull.

resources.description: The resources to fetch, such as [services]. Every resource its mappings read when left out.

mode.description: incremental fetches what changed; complete fetches everything and deletes what neither it nor the complete run before it saw of those resources.

checkStep.description: Counts the entities matching a filter and fails with the message unless the count is as expected. It gives count.

message.description: What to tell people when the check fails, saying what to do.

outputStep.description: Sets the summary and links the run page shows when the run is done.

approvalStep.description: Pauses the run until enough approvers approve, showing them what to review, such as a plan an earlier step made. One rejection ends the run. Whoever asked for the run can't approve it, and agents can't approve. It gives approvedBy and comments.

approvers.description: Who can approve: roles, groups, or a filter on the entity with $me as the approver, such as its owners. Admins always can.

timeout.description: How long to wait, up to 720h. Then the run fails.

message.description: What approvers are asked, which can hold {{ }} references.

review.description: What approvers see before deciding, in order.
One thing approvers see: markdown, such as a plan's summary, or a value shown as JSON.

markdown.description: Markdown text, which can hold {{ }} references or be one, such as $step.plan.body.summary.

json.description: A value shown as JSON, such as $step.plan.body.changes.
